text:
talia (Partnerships): Heads up 3: Marketplace onboarding asked for our compliance artifacts for a listing review: SOC2, summary of last pentest, asset inventory, signed attestation. They need something by EOD Fri. Any quick wins?

noah (Security): We can produce a redacted SOC2 + pentest summary. Do not share raw vulnerability output or customer data.

priya (Partner Ops): Plan proposal: assemble a ZIP with: redacted SOC, pentest executive summary + POA&M, inventory CSV (no customer IDs), signed attestation PDF, manifest + SHA256 checksums, and an access_instructions.txt with request path for sensitive artifacts. Use presigned links for any sensitive full artifacts.

omar (Eng-Infra): For presigned links I can create 7-day S3 presigns. Example: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1965432100/pentest_full.zip --expires-in 604800. I'll put the presign into a secure internal note, not in the public ZIP.

jess (Legal): I'll review attestation language. We need to state "no customer data included" and the scope of the attestation. Also confirm recipient org and marketplace account id before signing.

noah (Security): Redaction rules: remove customer names, emails, account IDs, sample payloads. Keep control narratives, test coverage, and remediation status. Add a redaction_log.txt explaining all removals.

priya (Partner Ops): Proposed bundle layout:
/evidence/
  soc2/soc2-redacted.pdf
  soc2/redaction_log.txt
  pentest/pentest-exec-summary.pdf
  pentest/p.o.a.m.high-level.pdf
  inventory/asset-inventory.csv
  attestations/marketplace-attestation-signed.pdf
  manifest.json (sha256 sums + file list)
  access_instructions.txt

(talia): That looks good. Who owns assembling and who signs?

noah (Security): I'll do redaction pass and provide checksums. Need temp upload location with SSE-KMS.

omar (Eng-Infra): Upload path: s3://redwood-sec-temp/1965432100/ with restricted ACL. Confirmed SSE-KMS.

jess (Legal): I'll sign once redaction_log + manifest are ready. Also, we should include a short SLA note if marketplace asks about update cadence for SOC.

priya (Partner Ops): I'll assemble bundle and create staging ZIP at s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1965432100/marketplace_bundle_1965432100.zip (staging). Will not make public until signoff.

noah (Security): Quick note re pentest vendor: strip tester PII; include vendor organization and scan dates only. If marketplace requests full raw output, require NDA + scoped transfer. Mention that in access_instructions.txt.

evidence-bot: Policy reminder: All artifacts at rest must be KMS-encrypted and presigned links must not exceed 14 days.

priya (Partner Ops): Action items: (1) noah -> redaction by 17:00 PT, (2) jess -> attestation sign upon review, (3) talia -> approve final bundle and release presigns, (4) omar -> generate presigns after approval.

talia (Partnerships): I'll inform the marketplace rep that we're sending a redacted bundle today and will provide a process for requesting deeper artifacts under NDA. Mentioning rep: marketplace-onboard@example.com

noah (Security): I'll post the redacted SOC and redaction_log to the staging path when done.

omar (Eng-Infra): Once talia gives thumbs up, I'll presign and drop the link to talia privately.

jess (Legal): Confirmed: we will not include customer PII. I'll prepare the signed attestation template and circulate for signature.

priya (Partner Ops): Uploading preliminary manifest with placeholders. Will update checksums after redaction artifacts are finalized.

talia (Partnerships): Thanks team, huge help. I'll consolidate and send to marketplace rep after signoff. :rocket:
